Whole-body proteostasis during growth and development
The growth of an individual in height and overall shape is mainly a function of bone growth which is genetically determined but
subject to a favorable diet and hazard-free environment. During the initial few months of life food intake occurs at very frequent
intervals, but after this growth and development adapts to a diurnal cycle of day-time feeding and nocturnal fasting during sleep.
This means from early-life the nutritional regulation of whole-body proteostasis during growth and development responds to not
